Height limit

Source: R/zones.R
height_limit.Rd

Height limit

Usage

height_limit(
  value = NULL,
  occupiable = NULL,
  roof_allowance = NULL,
  storeys = NULL,
  from_overlay = NULL,
  datum = "ground",
  no_limit = FALSE,
  source = NULL
)

Arguments

value

Maximum height (m) above the datum, including any roof allowance.

occupiable

Height (m) up to which floors may be built. Defaults to value - roof_allowance.

roof_allowance

Extra height (m) allowed for a roof form only, which yields no floor space.

storeys

The storey count the plan intends; storey height is taken as occupiable / storeys where given.

from_overlay

Name of an overlay that supplies the height where the zone states none (e.g. a height control map).

datum

What height is measured from: "ground" (existing ground, the default), "finished", "average" (average ground level), "road" or "sea_level" (an absolute level).

no_limit

TRUE if the plan sets no height limit; the rulebook's no_limit_height stand-in is used and results are flagged.

source

Citation.

Value

A list with class plancap_height.

Examples

height_limit(12, occupiable = 11, storeys = 3, source = "MRZ-S2")
#> $value
#> [1] 12
#> 
#> $occupiable
#> [1] 11
#> 
#> $storeys
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "MRZ-S2"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_height"
height_limit(from_overlay = "height_control", source = "MCZ-S1")
#> $from_overlay
#> [1] "height_control"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "MCZ-S1"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_height"
